# CV-23 — Contract cleanup

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-23-contract-cleanup` (cut from `maciej` after the Chat v2 release) · status: built, not landed
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261017130000_chat_v2_contract.sql` · applied to the local stack: yes (twice: it runs cleanly over itself)

## Delivered against the row

- **Retired signatures dropped** (`DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS`): `chat_op_send(uuid, text, uuid, uuid[], boolean, uuid, text)`, `chat_op_edit(uuid, text, uuid[])`, `chat_op_react(uuid, text)`, `chat_op_mark_read(uuid, timestamptz)`, `chat_op_mark_unread(uuid, timestamptz)`, `share_op_announce(uuid, boolean)`, `chat_normalize_channel_name(text)`. `chat_op_agent_post(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)` stays: the deployed connector calls it (`moduo-mcp/modules/chat.ts`, `chat_post` and `chat_reply`).
- **The `client_id` idempotency path:** `chat_op_send` (live body, CV-16's re-cut) no longer writes `client_id`; a send is idempotent on the id the client mints. The column and `chat_messages_client_uq` stay for v1 rows.
- **`chat_workspace_enabled(ws)`** answers only for a member of that workspace (its owner or a `workspace_members` row, `chat_is_workspace_member`) or for the service role (the connector); it is false for anyone else. Every caller was checked: the app's `isEnabled` (a member), `chat_op__guard` / `chat__op_guard_as` (check membership first), `chat_can_access_workspace` (the presence topic, a member), `attachments_op_begin` and `chat_emoji__may_upload` (an uploader in the workspace), `chat__key_actor` (the service role). No cron job reaches it.
- v1's `chat_messages_channel_idx` dropped (`chat_messages_stream_idx` serves the stream both ways).
- `chat_channels_name_trimmed` validated (prod had 0 untrimmed names, the orchestrator's read-only count, 2026-10-16).
- **`app_settings.min_build` = `1.0.21`**, and the check applies only to a desktop build whose version a release stamped (`minBuildApplies` in `src/lib/min-build.ts`, `APP_VERSION_STAMPED` from `rsbuild.config.ts`).
- The app: the v1 branches of `send` / `edit` in `runtime.chat.supabase.ts` are gone; `ChatBodyFormat` is `"v2"` only (no zombie union); `normalizeChannelName` (the client twin of the dropped SQL function, no caller) removed with its test.
- Tests moved off the dropped signatures: 12 chat SQL files, `tests/chat-plan.spec.ts` (v2 send), `tests/chat-shell.spec.ts` (`chat_op_set_announcement`).
- Drift gates: `CHAT_CHANNEL_KINDS` and `CHAT_NOTIFY_LEVELS` pinned to their CHECKs (they had none); the plan-source gate reads the newest `chat_workspace_enabled` body. Every other vocabulary on the brief's list was already pinned.

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **`min_build` = 1.0.21** (orchestrator approved, 2026-10-16): the desktop release workflow stamps `1.0.<run number>` (`_desktop-release.yml`, `MODUO_VERSION`). Production run #21 (2026-10-16 17:48 UTC) built `prod-app` at `18a00679e`, which contains Chat v2, and published `latest.json` version `1.0.21`; run #20 (`56c9c27d`) predates Chat v2. So 1.0.21 is the first production desktop build that sends only v2 signatures. Rejected: 1.0.20 (still calls v1 signatures). Staging builds stamp from their own run counter (1.0.41 today), above it by coincidence.
- **The minimum applies to stamped desktop builds only** (orchestrator approved): the web app reports `package.json`'s `1.0.0` and would be read-only under 1.0.21; dev and local builds report it too. The web app is always the latest deploy. Rejected: comparing every build (locks the web app out), or bumping `package.json` (the web version would still not say anything about age).
- **`client_id` stays as a column with its unique index** for v1 rows; only the write stops. Rejected: dropping the index (no gain: it is partial on non-null).
- **The plan tests ask as the service role** (`test.on`), since the answer now depends on who asks; the member rule has its own section.

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- A `Bun` / `rstest` component test whose mocked `useAuth()` returns a new `runtime` object on each call loops forever when the effect depends on `runtime` and sets external state: keep the mocked object stable.
- `bunx rstest <files>` without `run` starts watch mode and never exits in a non-interactive shell.

## For later blocks

- `chat__v1_to_v2` stays: the conversion and `chat_op_agent_post` (v1 markup from agents) use it.
- The brief's other "for CV-23" notes add behaviour and stay open: `chat__reopen` keeps `later_until`; the header count includes quiet lines; `notice__gate` runs up to three times per recipient; Catch up's "N held" polls without a Focus; `isQuietNow` has no caller; the §16 shortcut rows; `gatherExport`'s missing unit test.
- `scripts/spikes/chat/realtime-load.ts` and `realtime-columns.ts` still call v1's send (spike scripts, not run by any gate).

- [ ] On 1.0.21 → no strip, chat sends and edits → desktop app.
- [ ] On app.moduo.app → no strip, chat works → web.

## Verify before release

- **Order:** deploy the web app (and any desktop build) carrying `minBuildApplies` **before** applying the migration. The web app live now has no desktop-only check and reports 1.0.0, so it would go read-only the moment `min_build` reads 1.0.21. Desktop 1.0.21 is unaffected either way.
- No Edge Function change: `moduo-mcp` calls only `chat_op_agent_post(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)` and the v2 ops.
- Re-read prod's untrimmed channel names right before applying (the VALIDATE fails otherwise; 0 on 2026-10-16).
- Grants: the release snapshot (`snapshot-at` 15:03 UTC) predates the chat migrations on prod, so `chat_op_send(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)`'s grants come from its last migration (`20261017115000`); `chat_workspace_enabled`'s match the snapshot (authenticated, service_role).
